result.instructions: Tools for GHN, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Quote the shipping fee for a 2 kg parcel from district 1 to Hoan Kiem."; "Create a cash-on-delivery order for my customer, but ask me to confirm it first."; "What is the status of the order with my code SHOP-2026-00193?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes GHN data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run ghn_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run ghn_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run ghn_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. ghn_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: ghn_list_provinces
tools.title: List provinces
tools.description: List all provinces and cities with their ProvinceID. Use the ProvinceID with ghn_list_districts. Uses the district address model. GHN: GET /master-data/province.

tools.name: ghn_list_districts
tools.title: List districts
tools.description: List the districts of one province with DistrictID and service support (SupportType: 0 locked, 1 pickup only, 2 delivery only, 3 both). GHN: GET /master-data/district?province_id=.

tools.name: ghn_list_wards
tools.title: List wards
tools.description: List the wards of one district. Use WardCode (a string) for ghn_calculate_fee and ghn_create_order ward fields. GHN: GET /master-data/ward?district_id=.

tools.name: ghn_list_services
tools.title: List delivery services
tools.description: List the delivery services GHN offers on a route for this shop. Returns service_type_id (2 = under 20 kg, 5 = 20 kg or more or multi-parcel). Call it before ghn_calculate_fee. GHN: POST /v2/shipping-order/available-services.

tools.name: ghn_calculate_fee
tools.title: Calculate shipping fee
tools.description: Quote the shipping fee for a parcel to a ward, before creating an order. Quote only: no order is created. GHN: POST /v2/shipping-order/fee.

service_type_id.description: 2 = under 20 kg, 5 = 20 kg or more or multi-parcel.

from_district_id.description: Pickup district ID. Default: the shop address.

from_ward_code.description: Pickup WardCode. Default: the shop address.

cod_value.description: Cash on delivery amount in VND (maximum 50000000).

items.description: Items. Same shape as ghn_create_order items.

length.description: Length in cm. Required when service_type_id is 5.

width.description: Width in cm. Required when service_type_id is 5.

height.description: Height in cm. Required when service_type_id is 5.

weight.description: Weight in grams. Required when service_type_id is 5.

tools.name: ghn_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Get the full details of one shipping order by its GHN tracking code: status, parties, COD, fees and items. GHN: GET /v2/shipping-order/detail?order_code=.

order_code.description: GHN tracking code, e.g. LADFYR (returned by ghn_create_order).

tools.name: ghn_get_order_by_client_code
tools.title: Get an order by your code
tools.description: Get the full details of one shipping order by your own client_order_code instead of the GHN tracking code. GHN: GET /v2/shipping-order/detail-by-client-code?client_order_code=.

client_order_code.description: Your own order code (the client_order_code set when the order was created).

annotations.title: Get an order by your code

tools.name: ghn_create_order
tools.title: Create a shipping order
tools.description: CREATES A REAL SHIPPING ORDER: GHN picks up and delivers the parcel and can charge the shop or collect cash on delivery (COD) from the recipient. Call only after the user explicitly confirms the recipient, the parcel and the fee in this chat (use ghn_calculate_fee first). client_order_code is required: a retry with the same code returns the first order and creates no duplicate. Set to_district_name when is_new_to_address is false. Send content or items. GHN: POST /v2/shipping-order/create.

client_order_code.description: Your unique order code for this shop. Retries with the same code are safe.

to_ward_name.description: Recipient ward name (from ghn_list_wards or the new province model).

to_district_name.description: Recipient district name. Required when is_new_to_address is false.

is_new_to_address.description: true for the 2025 address model (ward and province only). Default false.

service_type_id.description: 2 = under 20 kg, 5 = 20 kg or more or multi-parcel (then items with sizes are required).

payment_type_id.description: Who pays the shipping fee: 1 = the shop, 2 = the recipient.

required_note.description: Delivery rule: KHONGCHOXEMHANG = no inspection, CHOXEMHANGKHONGTHU = inspect but do not try, CHOTHUHANG = inspect and try.

content.description: Goods description. Send content or items.

length.description: Length in cm. Required when service_type_id is 5.

width.description: Width in cm. Required when service_type_id is 5.

height.description: Height in cm. Required when service_type_id is 5.

weight.description: Weight in grams. Required when service_type_id is 5.

cod_amount.description: Cash on delivery to collect from the recipient, in VND. Default 0.

insurance_value.description: Declared insurance value in VND (maximum 5000000). Default 0.

tools.name: ghn_cancel_orders
tools.title: Cancel shipping orders
tools.description: CANCELS REAL SHIPPING ORDERS. The batch is all-or-nothing: one unknown or foreign order code cancels nothing. Call only after the user explicitly confirms the order codes. An order that can no longer be cancelled returns result false. GHN: POST /v2/switch-status/cancel.

items.description: GHN tracking code, e.g. LADFYR (returned by ghn_create_order).

order_codes.description: GHN tracking codes to cancel, in one batch.

reason_code.description: GHN-CO001 = pickup taking too long, GHN-CO002 = out of stock, GHN-CO003 = recipient no longer wants it, GHN-CANCEL-OTHER = other.

reason.description: Free-text reason for every order in the batch.
